description: Call BEFORE buying a token on Robinhood Chain. Returns ALLOW, DENY or REVIEW, every check with the fact it read, and an EIP-712 signed receipt. Missing data never gives ALLOW unless the policy says so.

unknown.description: What a deny rule with missing data means. Default review.

policy.description: A preset name ("actuary-default-v2", "actuary-judged-v2", "no-clones-v1"; v1 presets still work) or a policy object. Default: actuary-default-v2. See gate_facts.

name: gate
title: Gate a token
